sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule IX — Sanitary and Plumbing Systems
sources.description: Governs sanitary drainage systems, venting requirements, and wastewater disposal in Philippine buildings.

sources.label: Philippine Plumbing Code (PPC) — Sanitary Drainage System Standards
sources.description: Provides technical standards for sanitary drainage system components: pipe sizing, slopes, trap requirements, cleanout placement, and venting.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule IX, Sec. 906 — Drainage Pipe Slope Requirements
sources.description: Minimum pipe slopes for sanitary drainage: 1/4" per foot (2%) for pipes <=3" diameter, 1/8" per foot (1%) for pipes >=4" diameter.
